notes.title: Through His Eyes Demo – Patch n1.1d
notes.content:
This update focuses on removing frustration, sharpening immersion, and making sure your progress always feels earned—and never blocked.

Interactions That Work With You
Drawers now open like they should. No more fighting with clunky mechanics—just grab and explore smoothly.

Puzzles feel more fair. If you have the right item, you can use it. Simple as that.

Your Progress, Respected
Progress-saving issues fixed. If you grab an item, it's yours. If it's in the world, it's there for a reason. No more duplicates, confusion, or lost logic.

A progression blocker is gone. That moment where you couldn’t advance? It’s history.

Small Fixes, Big Impact
Repeating sounds no longer stack or bug out.

Inventory behaves correctly when closing it—no more phantom items.

Improved memory and cache handling for smoother transitions.

What’s Next
We’re working on making early puzzles hit harder with smarter challenge design and better emotional payoffs. Expect tighter storytelling and more “Aha!” moments in future updates.


Pablyco & Hopy

notes.title: The Demo Is Here! Play Through His Eyes Now – For Free!
notes.content:
Hey,

We're excited to share that the free demo for Through His Eyes is now available on Steam!

This demo offers around one hour of gameplay, giving you a first look at the game’s atmosphere, story, and core mechanics. It’s a standalone experience designed to give you a feel for what’s coming in the full release.

What’s Included:

- 25% – Narrative-driven exploration
    
- 20% – Puzzle solving
    
- 50% – Psychological tension and mystery
    
- 5% – Teddy bear
    

As a small team, your feedback means a lot to us. Feel free to share your thoughts, report any bugs, or let us know what stood out to you. Every comment helps us improve the final game.

If you enjoy the demo, please consider wishlisting the game, sharing it with others, or posting your playthroughs online.

Thanks for your support,  
Pablyco & Hopy – Poison Cat
